svg.title: AWS architecture deployed by composition/infra/eu-central-1/prod
svg.desc: VPC with three availability zones and public, private and isolate subnets, an ALB in front of an ECS Fargate service, ECR, optional EKS and VPN, and the S3/DynamoDB/KMS remote state backend.

text.tspan: What composition/infra and composition/remotebackend create with the committed terraform.tfvars

create_eks = false in prod tfvars · Kubernetes 1.32
⚠ The ALB is attached to module.vpc.private_subnets, whose default route is the NAT gateway, so it is not reachable from the internet as wired. See README › Known issues.
